descriptionChirho: Proper noun referring to the Gibeonite city Kiriath-Jearim (lit. 'city of forests'), located on the border of Judah and Benjamin, where the Ark of the Covenant rested after its return from Philistia; all 14 clusters represent the same place name split across inflectional prefixes (from-, in-, and-) and compound-word tokenization (Qiryath alone, Yearim alone, full compound).
